summary: The prepared base already contains upstream PR #35017's opt-in --prefill-decode-interval mitigation. The checked-out Scheduler reproduces uninterrupted prefill selection with interval 0 and enforces the configured decode cadence with interval 2; existing focused regressions and CLI validation pass. No duplicate scheduler change was made.

gpu_execution_evidence: No model/kernel workload was run. The available single gfx950 cannot reproduce the reported 8x B200 TP8 DeepSeek-V4-Flash/DSPARK deployment; GPU inventory is recorded separately.
remaining_limitations: The original 8x NVIDIA B200 TP8 and sustained production workload were not reproduced on the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.
DP-attention multi-rank synchronization was covered by the existing unit regression but not exercised in a distributed runtime.
The mitigation is opt-in; the default interval of 0 preserves strict prefill-first scheduling.
